description: The tune ASSET rows (default empty) — whole puck.audio.v1 documents embedded inline-canonical with pinned hashes (see WorldTune).

items.description: One tune ASSET row — a whole puck.audio.v1 document embedded INLINE-CANONICAL with its identity hash pinned beside it (the same hash-pin/canonicalize contract as WorldCreation): the compose boundary canonicalizes on upsert through AudioCanonicalizer and rejects a hash the pipeline did not itself compute; the validator re-verifies the pin on every candidate; world.save re-canonicalizes. The hash doubles as the runtime restart discriminator: a content change restarts the tune's headless host, a rename does not.

id.description: The row's stable string id — its mutation address and the handle a speaker's Tune references.

hash.description: The SHA-256 hex64 of the document's canonical bytes.
